summary: Frontend-only verification for GRK livestream fixes. Verified StickyShowVideo removal, .show-video-frame box-shadow cleaned, PersistentPlayer presenter-cutout conditional rendering, no horizontal overflow, Programma's regression. Livestream iframe (hero) was NOT present on this run (backend show has no video configured), so tests 2/3 (iframe stability + muted params) are N/A at runtime but code review confirms ShowVideo.jsx uses withMutedParams(muted=1&mute=1&autoplay=1) and useShowVideo does not setVideo(null) on transient errors. Presenter cutout not rendered in DOM because current show has empty presenter.image — this is the correct TEST6 fallback path; code guards render with {presenter.image && (...)}.
action_items: Optional: manually verify tests 2/3/5 when Koodh has a livestream video and a show with presenter image is on air (couldn't be reproduced during this run — no video and no presenter photo on current show).
critical_code_review_comments: PersistentPlayer.jsx conditional rendering is correct: cutout only when presenter.image truthy; fallback CoverImage remains in rounded square when !presenter.image.
ShowVideo.jsx correctly appends muted=1&mute=1&autoplay=1 through withMutedParams.
App.css .show-video-frame simplified to a single soft drop shadow only (verified via getComputedStyle).
App.js no longer imports/renders StickyShowVideo (only StickyPlayer).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for testable acceptance criteria (4/4 runtime-verifiable); 3/7 acceptance items are N/A due to no livestream + no presenter image on current show, but their code paths are code-reviewed and correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: During this run: no hero livestream iframe (data-testid='show-livestream-iframe') existed and PersistentPlayer's presenter.image was empty, so tests 2/3/5 could not be exercised at runtime. When a show with video + presenter image is live, re-run to confirm (a) hero iframe DOM node persists across scroll, (b) src contains muted=1, (c) [data-testid=persistent-player-presenter-cutout] appears with img.top < card.top and object-cover object-bottom classes.

runtime_verifications.TEST1_no_sticky_video: PASS — no [data-testid=sticky-show-video] before or after scroll; only 1 iframe present, and it is unrelated (no src attribute — likely from a third-party embed shell).
runtime_verifications.TEST4_no_blue_outline: PASS — .show-video-frame computed box-shadow is exactly 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 0px 24px 60px -10px' (no 74,143,220 blue and no 0px 0px 0px 3px ring).
runtime_verifications.TEST6_fallback_when_no_presenter_image: PASS — persistent-player-presenter-cutout not rendered when presenter.image is empty (verified in DOM over 16s of isShowView cycling).
runtime_verifications.TEST7_no_horizontal_overflow: PASS — desktop 1920 body=1920 client=1920; mobile 390 body=390 client=390.
runtime_verifications.TEST8_programmas_regression: PASS — /programmas loads (title 'GRK - the feelgood station', images render).
